lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p32 - Remember the story.

details: Remember the story checks retention of the first part. Students recall what the first two children saw (bus, bike) before moving to the new scene.
Look for correct recall of "bus" and "bike" when prompted.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p75 - 2. Tell the story to a friend.

details: Tell the story encourages oral retelling. Students use the matched pictures to retell the sequence of events to a partner using the target phrase "He sees..."
Look for students pointing to the pairs and saying sentences like "He sees an elephant" or "She sees a friend."
